messages.author: 875f0a74e1b42050
messages.subject: Distance sampling simulations
parts:
Dear Distance List,

I am pleased to announce the release of dsims 1.0.0 to CRAN.

dsims is our newer distance sampling simulation package that will replace the older simulation package DSsim. Please be advised that DSsim is now due for archive from CRAN on 24th August 2022. dsims makes simulations in R easier as it utilises the distance sampling survey design R package dssd and therefore removes the need to create transect shapefiles in advance. 

The code used in dsims is largely similar to DSsim but to aid a smooth transition for our existing DSsim users we are adapting the DSsim vignettes to demonstrate the code differences. The first of these is available now on our examples page: https://examples.distancesampling.org/dsims-truncation/dsims-examples.html

For those of you new to distance sampling simulations the 'Getting Started' vignette within the dsims package might be a better place to start. Once you have installed dsims in R you can view it by typing:  
vignette("GettingStarted", package = "dsims")

New Features, Enhancements and Bug Fixes in dsims version 1.0.0 can be found here: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/dsims/NEWS


If you have any issues using dsims or moving from using DSsim to dsims please do get in touch!


Best wishes,

Laura


Dr. L Marshall

Distance Development Team

Centre for Research into Ecological & Environmental Modelling

University of St. Andrews

Tel: +44 (0)1334 461808

Adrian

Solution would be to update your dsims​ to 1.0.1 from CRAN.  If your installation of R thinks you already have version 1.0.1 of dsims​ that you may have installed from Github (without the `build_vignettes = TRUE argument to `install_github​) then the simplest solution is to uninstall dsims​ from your machine and re-install from CRAN (which will build vignettes automatically).

Let me know if that works.
